question: Can source-only readout calibration recover foreground without changing the response field or ranking?
calibration_criterion: maximum ratio of soft expected source TP to source positive mass plus FP
threshold_candidates: k/512 for k=1,...,511; ties closest to 0.5 then smaller k; no positive source mass falls back to 0.5
source_split: sorted eligible reconstruction view index modulo 4; geometry and teacher tracks remain shared
calibration_pixels: same held-out view list and common valid pixels for source_fit and source_holdout; source_fit predicts them with the all-source field
final_field: all-source coverage_high for all three arms; split field used only to estimate source_holdout readout
